condition: If Error.prototype.toJSON has already been defined as non-writable (for example by an error-serialization library), loading axios throws "TypeError: Cannot assign to read only property 'toJSON'", because utils.inherits uses Object.assign to set AxiosError.prototype.toJSON.
workaround: Define Error.prototype.toJSON with writable: true, or import axios before the library that patches Error.prototype.
